Project: wordfreq
Authors: Robyn Speer / Luminoso Technologies
Source: https://github.com/rspeer/wordfreq
Data License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0)

wordfreq's word frequency data files are derived from multiple corpora (including Wikipedia,
Twitter/X, OpenSubtitles, Reddit, SUBTLEX, and Google Books Ngrams) and are redistributed
under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Under CC BY-SA 4.0:
- Attribution: Credit must be given to the creator (Robyn Speer / wordfreq).
- ShareAlike: If you remix, transform, or build upon the data, you must distribute
  your contributions under the same license (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Usage in Mosto键盘:
- Top ~39,000 English frequency entries extracted by `Tools/build_english.py` into
  `Tools/data/english.txt` and compiled to `Keyboard/Resources/english.bin` for
  offline mixed Chinese-English typing.

Full legal code: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/legalcode
